title: Reminders: when iOS notification permission was already decided, tapping the switch shows no alert; the switch stays off and tappable with nothing said
evidence: Decided 2026-11-26 (Brad: "go with your recommendations"): in this case the reminders section shows the existing Settings row, with no new words. Waits for the next iPhone build (App Store review open). Today: ios/HealthRoadmap/Reminders/RemindersSection.swift:17-22 the switch calls ask(); :53-56 sets refused only when permission reads denied after ReminderScheduler.optIn (ReminderScheduler.swift:91-95, which asks iOS again; iOS answers at once without a sheet once decided). :23-27 shows the Settings row only while optedIn, which a refusal never sets.
